result.brief: 提出 PrismWAM，将世界动作模型的状态解耦为语义规划与深度空间物理推演，再由深度 rollout 生成可执行动作，强调以物理状态而非外观表征世界。
result.reason: Decouples semantic vs physical state in world action models, using depth-space rollout for manipulation; state representation design is a world-model contribution, though primarily embodied policy.
